notes.title: Update on VAGUE (feat. Release Date)
notes.notes:
Following the unexpected attention sparked by a mysterious [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Brunei/comments/17hkw06/first_3d_horror_game_made_by_a_bruneian/]Reddit Post[/url] from an unknown user, the response from the local (Bruneian) community has been nothing short of astonishing. Word has even reached me through a friend's connection, indicating a surprising level of interest in my game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729738/04e246b73c151e341ddaa25d2b49e831bb61104a.jpg[/img]

This influx of attention brings a mix of emotions for me. 🫠

As a solo developer, VAGUE is planned to be a short interactive horror experience, but the sudden surge in popularity has both motivated and challenged me to elevate the game's quality to meet the growing expectations.

As a response, one of the significant enhancements I've focused on is a improving the graphics for the in-game characters. Here's a glimpse of the original version for the main character:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729738/c0c77fe6cf5ab16e13978bd9d9e0f54661637856.jpg[/img]

And here's the updated version:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44729738/b68528a4ded222910f55973b723d40499ee63e0d.jpg[/img]

Initially designed with "good enough PS3" graphics in mind, I found myself compelled to elevate it to a semi-realistic PS4 standard. I believe I've made considerable progress in achieving this goal!

[b]With that, I had to delay the release date to [u]November 2024[/u] (a year from now).[/b]

For latest updates on the game, you can follow me on [url=https://www.instagram.com/wollabebes/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wollabebes]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://youtube.com/@sce_games]YouTube[/url]!

That wraps up the latest updates from me, and I'm eager to reveal more aspects of the game soon! Until then, farewell!

- Wollabebes
